### Source: E&F's own company_BasicBank, with the building list filtered and the
### three regime currencies added.
###
### ONE company for every country that has no historical central bank of its own.
### There were ninety-five of these, one per currency law, identical but for the
### key -- and the branch chains they forced on the dispatcher, the grant and the
### monopoly pass overflowed the stack for any country that fell through all of
### them. See gen_generic_banks in the generator for the crash report.
###
### 2 ownership entries dropped from E&F's list (railway, trade centre) and
### building_bank added: a central bank owns banks, not railways.
###
### `replaces_company` is deliberately not copied from BasicBank -- it points at
### company_basic_bank, which exists nowhere.
